review.content_class_rationale: Extracted the single member cells-1232824-supplementary.pdf from the ZIP (9 A4 pages) and viewed every rendered page and its text layer: page 1 is a methods paragraph on the single threshold permutation test (SnPM); pages 2, 3 and 9 are Figures S1, S2 and S6, histograms of t-values per band with printed critical-t labels for the PSD, connectivity and Lempel-Ziv complexity comparisons; pages 4 to 6 are Figures S3 to S5, charts of five graph metrics against connection density for delta, theta and alpha; pages 7 and 8 are Tables S1 to S3 with graph-metric statistics (|t0.05|, t-value, p-value, pFDR) per band for the visual hallucination versus resting-state comparison of the index patient.

review.notes: Single-patient article: the Results cite SM Figures S1, S2, S6 and Tables S1 to S3 for the index patient EEG comparisons, and the PDF prints no patient identifier. The theta connectivity threshold printed in Figure S2 differs from the main Figure 3 caption. Clinical values are not recorded here; they belong in the supplemental clinical reference sidecar.
